findings.title: An empty scope authorizes every warehouse
findings.trigger: A key issued without warehouses (issue_key's default), narrowed to none with set_scope(key, []), or read from a key row with no warehouses field calls reserve, confirm, cancel, pick, or stock.
findings.impact: authorize skips the scope test whenever key.warehouses is empty, so a key that normalize_scope documents as able to act in no warehouse can move stock in every warehouse. An admin who parks a kiosk key by clearing its scope widens it to the whole network instead. The check should be WILDCARD not in scope and warehouse_id not in scope, with no truthiness short-circuit.

findings.title: The expiry query scans every reservation on each tick
findings.trigger: A store with a long reservation history and the worker ticking every 30 seconds.
findings.impact: holds_expiring_before parses every row to find the few HELD ones; an index on status and expires_at would keep each tick cheap as history grows.
